## Où j'en suis
The PostgreSQL 17 upgrade is on branch `noa/rds-pg17`, with draft PR #57 still open. Staging is on PostgreSQL 17.2 after the blue/green switchover; `pg_partman` was upgraded and maintenance completed, and the staging dbt run passed all 14 models. Production remains disabled and has no scheduled window: Maya wants a full week of staging on 17 before sign-off. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-linear-kes298)

- [en-cours] Observe staging on PostgreSQL 17.2 for a full week before production sign-off; no incident is reported so far. (source: src-linear-kes298, src-slack-infra)
- [prochaine-étape] After the staging week and sign-off, choose the production window; then set `rds.logical_replication = 1` and reboot production before creating the blue/green deployment. (source: src-linear-kes298, ses-pg-3)
- [décision] Keep production’s date unset until Maya signs off after a full week on staging. (source: s3-09, src-linear-kes298)
